notes: The tune: compiled Sound Tracker ("MARK 800", STC, collection XMX2 by the music index) in the music piece at `$C000`, kept as text (`music/`, kind stc1: head, the shared stc player, the stop's tail, stc.txt). The build packs it with tools/lzpack.py (byte-exact, no hints) behind the depacker head `parts/depack.ann`; the init depacks in place through the printer buffer `$5B8D` and leaves through `JP $0052`, the 48K ROM's RET.
The BASIC still reads 10 sectors of music (the original's count with the music at `$C000`); the file holds 8, so the read takes 2 sectors past the file's end.

ReadCatalogueSafe (`parts/safe.ann`, at `$6FE0` in the menu's spare bytes) traps disk errors through ERR_SP and stops the drive after reading; Start and the SPACE key call it (code switch `catalogue-safe`).

packed.head: parts/depack.json
packed.why: the music piece (compiled Sound Tracker, $C000-$C9D6) packed by tools/lzpack.py behind parts/depack.ann; its last 2 bytes stay raw after the end mark (the LDDR puts them in place); after the hook RET the sector keeps the unpacked piece's bytes (the packer wrote over them)
